DEWA Bill Calculator (Dubai Electricity and Water)

Enter the electricity and water use from your bill and your annual rent to see the expected bill line by line.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Estimate your bill

As on the bill since March 2025; one m³ is about 220 gallons.

DEWA slab tariff

Electricity (kWh a month)Residential and commercialUAE national's home
Up to 2,00023 fils7.5 fils
2,001–4,00028 fils9 fils
4,001–6,00032 fils10.5 fils
Over 6,00038 fils12.5 fils
Water (m³ a month)ResidentialCommercial and industrial
First slabUp to 27: AED 7.70Up to 45: AED 7.70
Second slab27–54: AED 8.8045–91: AED 8.80
Third slabOver 54: AED 10.12Over 91: AED 10.12

Industrial electricity is 23 fils up to 10,000 kWh, then 38 fils. Add the monthly fuel surcharge (November 2026: 6 fils per kWh and AED 1.10 per m³), meter charges of AED 5 to 35, and 5% VAT.

Dubai Municipality fees on the bill

  • Housing fee: 5% of the annual rent ÷ 12 a month; resident owners pay 5% of the estimated rental value; UAE nationals are exempt.
  • Sewerage charge: 2 fils per gallon of water in 2026, rising to 2.8 fils from January 2027.

Example: a flat using 1,500 kWh and 20 m³ with an annual rent of AED 120,000, in November 2026: electricity 345 + fuel surcharge 90, water 154 + fuel surcharge 22, meters 10, so DEWA's items come to 621 plus VAT 31.05, sewerage 87.99 and housing fee 500. About AED 1,240 in total.

The calculator gives an estimate; the actual bill follows the meter reading, the number of days in the billing cycle and that month's fuel surcharge.

Frequently asked questions

How is a DEWA bill calculated?

Electricity is charged by monthly slabs, each part at its own rate, and water by the cubic metre, plus a fuel surcharge on every kWh and m³, meter charges and 5% VAT on those items. DEWA also collects Dubai Municipality's sewerage charge and housing fee on the same bill.

What is the price per kWh in Dubai?

For residential and commercial accounts: 23 fils up to 2,000 kWh, 28 up to 4,000, 32 up to 6,000 and 38 fils above that, plus a fuel surcharge of 6 fils per kWh in November 2026 and 5% VAT.

What is the water price per cubic metre in Dubai?

For homes: AED 7.70 per m³ up to 27, 8.80 up to 54 and 10.12 above, plus a fuel surcharge of AED 1.10 per m³ in November 2026. Water has been billed in cubic metres instead of gallons since March 2025.

What is the housing fee on the DEWA bill?

A Dubai Municipality fee of 5% of the annual rent, split over 12 months on the bill; resident owners pay 5% of the estimated rental value. UAE nationals are exempt.

How much is the sewerage charge in Dubai?

Dubai Municipality raised it in phases: 1.5 fils a gallon in 2025, 2 fils in 2026 (about AED 4.40 per m³) and 2.8 fils from January 2027 (about AED 6.16 per m³), charged on water use.

Is the tariff different for UAE nationals?

Yes, under Executive Council Resolution 16 of 2011: electricity at 7.5, 9, 10.5 and 12.5 fils for the same slabs, water free up to 10,000 gallons (about 45 m³) then 1.5 fils a gallon, and no fuel surcharge on nationals' homes.
